profiles.scenario: Fictional adult receiving active cancer treatment at home
profiles.care_phase: Active treatment; fictional treatment visit during window

baseline.mobility: Usually walks dog, dresses and showers independently.
baseline.nutrition: Usually eats three small meals and drinks fluids throughout day.
baseline.energy: Usually active much of day; sleeps about 7 hours.

timeline_events.description: Fictional scheduled cancer-treatment visit; no drug or regimen specified.
Fictional nurse asks caregiver to track energy, intake and daily functioning.

profiles.scenario: Fictional adult recovering at home after non-specific surgery
profiles.care_phase: Post-operative home recovery; surgery occurred before this window

baseline.mobility: Initially walks short distances indoors with family nearby.
baseline.energy: Tired at times but usually alert and conversational.

timeline_events.description: Synthetic timeline anchor; exact surgery date unspecified.
Fictional follow-up; caregiver asked to record changes and raise concerns.

profiles.scenario: Fictional adult gradually recovering from a non-specific lower-limb injury
profiles.care_phase: Home recovery; no specific diagnosis or protocol provided

baseline.mobility: Usually independent at home and takes short walks.
baseline.sleep: Usually sleeps 7–8 hours; occasional interruption by discomfort.

timeline_events.description: Synthetic observation window begins; exact injury date unspecified.
Caregiver reports Alex tried a slightly longer walk; not a clinician-prescribed milestone.
